title: OneMap basemap services and attribution requirements
licence: Streamed basemap embedding per official service documentation; required OneMap logo and source attribution. No local tile archive or redistribution.
intended_use: Viewport-limited client-side display of OneMap Default/Grey and Satellite orthophoto tiles with OneMap/SLA attribution. No local imagery archive or copied 3D meshes.
notes: Base tiles in EPSG:3857, zoom 11–19. Present-day reference only; map update epoch varies by tile. No historical reconstruction implied. Service availability remains external. SLA OneMap3D launch publication explicitly describes orthophoto as a photographic basemap. Satellite XYZ endpoint verified HTTP 200 on 2026-09-14; capture dates are not known and imagery is not live. Satellite is not listed among the four older basemap examples, so service continuity is not guaranteed.

title: Bounded CBD building-footprint extract
licence: Open Database Licence 1.0 (ODbL); attribution and share-alike for the derived database.
intended_use: Publish the filtered, transformed footprint database under ODbL and render simplified building massing. Per-feature source IDs and height-basis labels remain available.
notes: Community mapping is not independently verified. Actual OSM height tags, floor-count-derived estimates and illustrative defaults are distinguished. Partial CBD coverage only. Public surface context, not underground infrastructure or access geometry. Overpass queries timed out; one smaller bounded core API map response succeeded.

title: Named MRT station search references
licence: Singapore Open Data Licence 1.0; source and access-date attribution; no agency endorsement.
intended_use: Offline station-position comparison and attributed geographic network display.
notes: Selected station results retained offline with original SEARCHVAL, X/Y and longitude/latitude. Not exit coordinates. Planned CR/JRL platform matches excluded. Interchanges use the explicitly identified named platform reference, not an averaged centre. Search response included results alongside a token warning; no credentials or access-control bypass used. No runtime geocoding dependency.
